subject: Price match request — Nimbus evaluation and migration package
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbussys.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: price match & migration incentives

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are evaluating Redwood vs our incumbent (Nimbus Systems) for production inference and procurement has asked us to explore whether Redwood can match the commercials Nimbus has offered. They are proposing a 12-month renewal with a migration credit and a two-month cost-free onboarding window.

Two asks from my side:
- Can Redwood match or better the list unit price for the core inference SKU (they've quoted $0.0045/token for our expected volume)?
- Would Redwood provide migration incentives (one-time credits + engineering onboarding hours) to offset switching effort?

I attached our current RFP/pricing sheet for context (see Nimbus_RFP_and_pricing_sheet.xlsx). Procurement also wants a short comparison doc and a clear path to contract/signature.

Can you loop in pricing and legal? We are hopeful to decide in the next 10 business days.

Best,
Sarah Lee
Head of AI Ops, Nimbus Systems
sarah.lee@nimbussys.com

---
Attachment: Nimbus_RFP_and_pricing_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbussys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Bcc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: price match & migration incentives

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending this over and for the clarity. I’ve looped in Ben (pricing) and Marissa (acct exec). Priyom (customer success) is on a short Bcc to help size the onboarding support.

Quick notes up front:
- We typically compete on TCO (latency + token economics + caching) rather than a direct token-for-token match, but we do run targeted price-match and migration packages for strategic renewals.
- I’ll ask Ben to prepare a short side-by-side TCO with an explicit one-time migration incentive recommendation.

Can you confirm two things before we finalize:
1) Your 12-month volume profile (monthly tokens) — the RFP sheet had ranges but not month-by-month.
2) Any non-price contractual items Nimbus insisted on (data residency, audit rights) that are must-haves.

I’ll get back with numbers within 24 hours.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbussys.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:30:00Z
Subject: Redwood <> Nimbus: cost comparison + matching proposal

Evelyn/Marissa/Sarah — attaching a concise comparison (redwood_vs_nimbus_tco_summary.pdf) and a proposed commercial term sheet. Summary highlights:

- Raw token price: Redwood baseline for their volume tier is $0.0050/token. Nimbus quoted $0.0045/token.
- Effective TCO at expected profile: after typical caching and batching, Redwood’s effective per-token can drop to $0.0038 with recommended autoscale and KV caching. I show a modeled 14% lower monthly spend over 12 months when accounting for throughput savings.

Proposed package to win the renewal:
1) One-time migration credit: $60k applied as a first-invoice credit (to offset migration project costs).
2) 10% list price discount for the first 12 months for the committed tier (not stackable with other promotions).
3) 40 hours of onboarding engineering (remote) + access to the migration onboarding playbook (migration_onboarding_playbook.pdf).
4) SLA uplift clause for the first 6 months and a rollback safety net (ability to fallback to Nimbus during a 30-day initial window).

Attachments: redwood_vs_nimbus_tco_summary.pdf, migration_onboarding_playbook.pdf

Open items:
- Legal has to sign off on the rollback language and credit application (Marissa, can you confirm typical approval cadence?).
- Need Sarah’s month-by-month volume to finalize the credit calibration.

If approved, I can convert this into a short playbook + term sheet for signature (DocuSign link included once legal clears).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: redwood_vs_nimbus_tco_summary.pdf (pdf), migration_onboarding_playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbussys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jim Parker <jim.parker@procureops.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood <> Nimbus: cost comparison + matching proposal

Ben/Evelyn — thanks for the quick analysis. A few follow-ups from procurement and engineering:

- Procurement note (Jim): the migration credit is the most important lever — can it be guaranteed in the signed agreement rather than applied ad hoc?
- Engineering note: the 40 hours of onboarding is helpful, but we will need at least another 20 hours of dedicated infra support during the first 90 days (on-call) to ensure parity.

I’ve pasted our month-by-month expected tokens in a short table below (approx):
Jul-26: 220M
Aug-26: 245M
Sep-26: 260M
Oct-26: 270M
Nov-26: 285M
Dec-26: 300M

Can Redwood convert the proposed package to a firm offer with:
- $60k migration credit as a contract line item
- 10% first-year discount confirmed in term sheet
- 60 hours of onboarding/support (40 remote + 20 guaranteed infra on-call)
- Proposed start date: target go-live Nov 1, 2026 (we need contract signed by Oct 8 to meet this).

Let me know — we’re actively balancing internal momentum and Nimbus’s retention team is pressing.

Best,
Sarah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbussys.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jim Parker <jim.parker@procureops.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood <> Nimbus: cost comparison + matching proposal

Sarah — appreciate the clarity and the month-by-month profile. I’ve flagged legal to put the $60k credit as a line item and to add the 10% discount in the first-year pricing schedule. A couple of contractual notes:

- We can add the migration credit as a contract credit (applies to first invoice) — legal will include language so it cannot be clawed back.
- SLA uplift and rollback clause need a short negotiation; legal asks that rollback be limited to a documented service-impact window and tied to specific performance thresholds.
- We can commit to 60 hours of onboarding/support (40 remote + 20 infra on-call for 90 days).

Next steps I propose:
1) I will get the term sheet drafted today and publish via DocuSign for signature (https://www.docusign.com/en/link/xyz-123-sign).
2) Once signed, Priyom will schedule technical kickoff and our onboarding calendar.

Sarah — I’ll copy the draft here in an hour. If that timeline works I’ll include a note to legal for expedited review.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
